title: The ordinary root cone under the normalized linear isomorphism
statement: Let l be prime, T a scheme with [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-models], c over ULift(Q_l), r and normalized coefficients k [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-coefficients], H a strict root system with roots identification, t the ordinary completed-root limit isomorphism with its prescribed underlying root-limit map, and e:H≅r.F(lineModule(c)) whose underlying additive map is roots.hom≫k.lineForget.inv. Then for every n, t.hom≫limit.projection(H,n)≫e.hom(n)=k.lineProjection(n).

source.place: paragraph (2), finite Cartier normalization and forget supports, before the divisor line is decomposed; diagonal-limit clause (3), and classes proof (3)

proof.text: Forget scalars and postcompose k.lineForget.hom(n), a monomorphism. The normalization of e cancels k.lineForget inverse. The inverse preserved-limit comparison and the inverse diagram-isomorphism comparison followed by projection give the root-limit projection. k.line_projection gives that same map for the coefficient cone. Faithfulness of forgetting proves the equality of the original linear sheaf arrows.

theorem diagonalTrace_normalizedRootCone (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (T : Scheme.{u})
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l T]
    (c : SpTowerClasses.Chern l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) T)
    (r : Restriction l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) T)
    (k : Coefficients l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) T c r)
    (H : DiagonalSystems l T)
    (roots : H ⋙ diagonalForget l T ≅
      Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnityTower T l (Fact.out : l.Prime))
    (t : (diagonalCompletedRestriction l T).obj (Scheme.purTwistZlModule T l) ≅ limit H)
    (ht : HEq ((diagonalForget l T).map t.hom)
      (diagonalRootLimitComparison l T H roots).inv)
    (e : H ≅ r.F.obj (SpTowerClasses.lineModule l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) c))
    (he : Functor.whiskerRight e.hom (diagonalForget l T) =
      roots.hom ≫ k.lineForget.inv) (n : ℕ) :
    t.hom ≫ limit.π H (op n) ≫ e.hom.app (op n) = k.lineProjection.app (op n)
